svg.text: Investigative AI Training Arena · tiered architecture
Six tiers from the browser to the model vendors, with the cross-cutting concerns on the right. Every flow is also drawn as Mermaid in architecture.md.
React 19 + Vite on :5173 · Unissant typeface and gold accent · api.js adds Authorization: Bearer and sends a 401 back to the login page
appear only after a finding is locked
FastAPI on :8000 · CORS for the dev server · every route except /health and /auth/* requires a bearer token
mock rules, L0 and L1 loops
Candidate registry: model + prompt version + tools + policy · HarnessProfile removes filesystem, shell and subagent tools · AssistantContext is the isolation boundary
backend/data (gitignored) · configuration in backend/.env via pydantic-settings, where .env takes precedence over the OS environment
USD per MTok per model id
cost column, zero on cache hits
llm.py · one LangChain chat model per candidate (model id + effort) · identical calls served from the cache before any vendor is contacted
credentials only in backend/.env · the gateway option replaces the three vendors with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
services invoked per request or in a background thread
save sessions and runs · look up the response cache · mirror locked sessions
chat model per candidate · effort · rate limiter · cache miss only
service layer calling the model layer directly
data layer mirroring to Neo4j Aura
